Players Committee card image of [[Slip Sliding Away (V)]] (Virtual Set 12), October 2020 errata (card marked “E”), printing: “If you have deployed a site with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a battleground site. Then, unless you have deployed Imperial Square or a site with "Palace" in title, deploy up to three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d5f24d6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/slipslidingaway.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/slipslidingaway.gif] as of commit d5f24d6 “oct 2020 errata” (14 October 2020).
